quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: It is your first day at a new school and you do not know anyone.
quests.hint: Think about how you feel meeting new people for the first time.
quests.explanation: Feeling nervous is natural on your first day somewhere new. It shows you care about making a good impression. 'Nervous' means feeling a little worried and unsure.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You find a small puppy sitting alone in the park.
quests.hint: Puppies are cute and friendly animals!
quests.explanation: Most people feel happy when they see a puppy. 'Happy' means you feel good and pleased about something.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You forgot to bring your lunch to school today.
quests.hint: Think about what your body feels when you have no food.
quests.explanation: When you forget your lunch you feel hungry because you have nothing to eat at lunchtime.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your friend gives you a birthday present wrapped in colorful paper.
quests.hint: Getting a gift is a kind and special gesture!
quests.explanation: Receiving a gift makes most people feel happy and appreciated.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: A large dog runs toward you and barks very loudly.
quests.hint: A loud rushing dog can feel very threatening.
quests.explanation: When a large dog runs at you and barks it is natural to feel scared.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You win a board game against your older brother.
quests.hint: Think about how athletes feel after winning.
quests.explanation: Winning makes you feel proud of your effort and skill.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: It starts raining heavily on the day of your outdoor picnic.
quests.hint: Your plans are ruined by the bad weather.
quests.explanation: When something you planned does not happen because of weather you feel disappointed.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your mother cooks your absolute favorite meal for dinner.
quests.hint: Someone has done something kind and thoughtful for you.
quests.explanation: When someone does something kind for you like cooking your favorite food you feel grateful.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You cannot find your house keys anywhere and need to leave now.
quests.hint: Something important is missing and you need it right now.
quests.explanation: Losing important things makes you feel worried because something might go wrong.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your parents buy you the video game you wanted for months.
quests.hint: You have been waiting a long time for this!
quests.explanation: Getting something you have wanted for a long time makes you feel excited.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You have to get an injection at the doctor's office.
quests.hint: Most people do not enjoy needles even adults!
quests.explanation: Getting a shot at the doctor makes many people feel scared.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You watch a very funny movie with your whole family.
quests.hint: The movie makes everyone laugh out loud.
quests.explanation: When you watch something funny you feel amused.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Today is your birthday and your friends are all at your party.
quests.hint: Your friends are celebrating with you!
quests.explanation: Having all your friends celebrate your birthday makes you feel very happy.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You just learned to ride a bicycle without any help.
quests.hint: You did something difficult completely by yourself!
quests.explanation: Learning a new skill like riding a bike makes you feel proud.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: There is a very loud thunderstorm outside at night.
quests.hint: Loud sudden thunder can be startling and scary.
quests.explanation: A loud thunderstorm at night can make you feel frightened.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your football team loses an important match.
quests.hint: You tried your best but your team did not win.
quests.explanation: Losing a game after trying hard makes you feel disappointed.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You help an elderly lady carry her heavy shopping bags.
quests.hint: You did something kind for someone who needed help.
quests.explanation: Helping others makes you feel good inside.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You get a much lower grade on your test than you expected.
quests.hint: You expected better results after studying hard.
quests.explanation: Getting a grade lower than you expected makes you feel upset.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: A new student joins your class and sits next to you.
quests.hint: You want to know more about this new person.
quests.explanation: When someone new comes to your class it is natural to feel curious about them.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your pet dog is sick and has to stay at the animal hospital.
quests.hint: Someone you love and care for is not feeling well.
quests.explanation: When a pet you love is sick you naturally feel worried.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: The ice cream shop is giving away free ice cream today!
quests.hint: Free food that you really love!
quests.explanation: Getting something you enjoy for free makes you feel excited.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You are stuck in heavy traffic and will be very late for school.
quests.hint: You cannot move and time is running out.
quests.explanation: Being stuck in traffic when you need to be somewhere makes you feel frustrated.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You wake up and smell fresh pancakes cooking downstairs.
quests.hint: Something delicious is being made just for you!
quests.explanation: Waking up to the smell of your favorite food makes you feel happy.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You get separated from your parents in a very crowded shopping mall.
quests.hint: You are alone in a crowded place and cannot find your family.
quests.explanation: Getting separated from your parents in a busy place makes you feel panicked.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your school is cancelled today because of heavy snow!
quests.hint: No school today and lots of snow to play in!
quests.explanation: A snow day with no school makes most children feel delighted.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your best friend tells you they are moving to another city.
quests.hint: Someone you love very much is going far away.
quests.explanation: When a close friend moves away you feel sad because you will miss them.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your parents ask you to taste a new food you have never tried before.
quests.hint: You do not know yet if you will like this new food.
quests.explanation: Being asked to try something unknown makes you feel hesitant meaning a little unsure before trying.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your teacher gives you an award in front of the whole class.
quests.hint: Your teacher is recognizing your hard work publicly.
quests.explanation: Receiving an award in front of others makes you feel proud.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: Your family takes you to a water park for the very first time.
quests.hint: This is a fun new adventure with your whole family!
quests.explanation: Visiting a new exciting place for the first time makes you feel excited.

quests.instruction: Choose the bubble that fits the mood.
quests.scene: You have to stand for the whole journey on a very crowded bus.
quests.hint: There is no room and many strangers are very close to you.
quests.explanation: Standing in a packed crowded bus makes you feel uncomfortable.
